spans.s: शिबि(वि) m. 1. A beast of prey; 2. the birch tree; 3. name of a king.
शिबि(वि)का f. 1. A palanquin, a litter; 2. a bier.
शिबि(वि)र n. 1. A camp, an encampment, संध्यांशुभिन्नघनकर्बुरितांतरीक्षलक्ष्मीविडंबि शिबिरं शिवकीर्तनस्य Sis.v.68; 2. an intrenchment for the protection of an army; 3. a kind of grain.
शिबी(वी)रथ m. A palanquin, a litter.
शिव (I) a. (f. वा) Auspicious, happy, lucky, fortunate, जहासि निद्रामशिवैः शिवारुतैः Kir.i.38, R.xi.33.

शिव (II) m. 1. Name of the third deity in the Hindu triad, entrusted with the work of destruction, शिवमगात्मजया च कृतेर्ष्यया सकलहंसगणं शुचिमानसम् Kir.v.13; 2. an auspicious planetary conjunction; 3. final emancipation; 4. the Veda; 5. a god; 6. the male organ of generation; 7. quick-silver; 8. bdellium; 9. a post to which cattle are tied.
शिव (III) m. du. Śiva and Pārvatī.
शिव (IV) n. 1. Prosperity, happiness, well-being, उपपन्नं ननु शिवं सप्तस्वंगेषु R.i.60; 2. final beatitude; 3. water; 4. sea-salt; 5. rock-salt.
शिव (I) a. (f. वा) Auspicious, happy, lucky, fortunate, जहासि निद्रामशिवैः शिवारुतैः Kir.i.38, R.xi.33.
शिवा f. 1. An epithet of Pārvatī; 2. a jackal, जहासि निद्रामशिवैः शिवारुतैः Kir.i.38, R.vii.50; 3. final emancipation; 4. the Śamī tree; 5. a kind of yellow pigment (गोरोचना); 6. the Dūrvā grass.
शिव-अक्ष n. the same as रुद्राक्ष q.v.
शिव-आत्मक n. rock-salt.
शिव-आदेशक m. a fortune-teller.
शिव-आलय (I) m. the red basil.
शिव-आलय (II) n. 1. a temple sacred to Śiva; 2. a cemetery.
शिव-इतर a. inauspicious, unlucky.
शिवंकर a. auspicious.
शिव-कांची f. name of a city.
शिव-घर्मज m. the planet Mars.
शिव-ताति (I) a. conferring happiness, propitious, प्रयत्नः कृत्स्नोऽयं फलतु शिवतातिश्च M.M.vi.
शिव-ताति (II) f. auspiciousness.
शिव-दत्त n. the discus of Viṣṇu.
शिव-दारु n. the Devadāru tree.
शिव-द्रुम m. the Bilva tree.
शिव-द्विष्टा f. the ketaka tree.
शिव-धातु m. quick-silver.
शिव-पुर n. a name of Benares.
शिव-पुरी f. a name of Benares.
शिव-पुराण n. name of one of the eighteen Purāṇas.
शिव-प्रिय m. 1. crystal; 2. the thorn-apple.
शिवा-प्रिय m. a goat.
शिव-मल्लक m. the Arjuna tree.
शिव-राजधानी f. a name of Benares.
शिव-रात्रि f. the fourteenth day of the dark half of Māgha sacred to Śiva.
शिव-लिंग n. Śiva in the form of a phallus.
शिव-लोक m. the world of Śiva.
शिव-वल्लभ m. the mango tree.
शिव-वाहन m. a bull.
शिव-वीज n. quick-silver.
शिव-शेखर m. the moon.
शिव-सुंदरी f. an epithet of Durgā.
शिवक m. 1. A post to which cattle are tied; 2. a post for cattle to rub against.
शिवा-अराति m. a dog.
शिवा-फला f. the Śamī tree.
शिवा-रुत n. the howling of a jackal, Kir.i.38.
शिवानी f. Pārvatī, wife of Śiva.
सीवनी f. 1. A needle; 2. the frenum of the prepuce.
शिवालु m. A jackal.
शीवन् m. A large snake.
सिव् vt. 4P (pp. स्यूत; pres. सीव्यति) 1. To sew, to stitch together, मनोभवः सीव्यति दुर्यशःपटौ Na.i.80; 2. to unite, to join.With अनु-, to string together or connect uninterruptedly.
सीव् vt. The same as सिव् q.v.
सिवर m. An elephant.
सी(से)वन n. 1. Sewing, stitching; 2. a seam, a suture.
